summary: The design needs a separate brief state model rather than adapting the current feature/hotfix metadata and index assumptions. The highest risks are incompatibility with the coder/checkpoint pipeline, incomplete `/sdd-done` migration, and ledger/worktree lifecycle failures.

suggestions.title: Add a brief-specific worktree plan
suggestions.rationale: `FlowMeta` only models `feature|hotfix`, and its validator forces hotfixes to `main`; `plan_worktree()` only accepts FEAT IDs or Jira keys, while `ensure_worktree` exposes only those inputs. A ledger brief based on `dev` cannot be represented without violating the existing type contract. Add a separate brief plan/API with an explicit stable key and base branch, without changing `FlowMeta`; also resolve the design's inconsistent `fix-...` versus `fix/...` naming.

suggestions.title: Do not use null feature_id with the unchanged coder pipeline
suggestions.rationale: The proposed `feature_id: null` conflicts with current consumers: coder checkpoint validation rejects a missing feature ID, `ExecutionPoolView.feature_id` requires a non-empty string, and engine feature resolution only scans `sdd/tasks/index`. Either use a non-allocated stable brief identity in `feature_id` or explicitly make every coder/checkpoint/inspection path brief-aware; the claimed zero-Python-change downstream boundary is not currently true.

suggestions.title: Make the brief index path explicit in ResearchOutput
suggestions.rationale: `DevelopmentNode` currently treats an empty `feat_id` as having no task index, and `_build_scheduler()` derives the index by scanning `sdd/tasks/index/<feature>.json`. A brief stored at `sdd/briefs/<slug>.index.json` will silently degrade to single-agent execution unless the research result carries an explicit brief/index identity. Add a validated brief/index path or resolver and test both single-task and `--split` briefs.

suggestions.title: Implement `/sdd-done` as separate feature and brief state machines
suggestions.rationale: The current command resolves only `sdd/tasks/index`, reads a spec, closes `active/` task files with `close_task.sh`, assumes FEAT IDs for E2E/reporting, and uses feature-specific branch names. A brief has no spec/FEAT ID and uses in-place task closure plus brief validation commands. Add a dedicated brief resolver/verifier and keep the existing feature path isolated; otherwise partial conditionals will leave impossible paths such as `feature_id == null` passed to feature-only tooling.

suggestions.title: Make main-target PR creation automatic and fail-closed
suggestions.rationale: The current hotfix branch explicitly prints a manual `gh pr create` command and exits successfully; it also hardcodes `feat-<FEAT-ID>-<slug>`, which is invalid for no-ID briefs. The implementation must call `gh pr create --base "$BASE_BRANCH" --head "$BRANCH"`, return the URL, and retain the worktree/branch on failure. `--merge` must be rejected before any push or merge operation when the resolved base is `main`.

suggestions.title: Unset and verify branch upstream immediately after worktree creation
suggestions.rationale: `ensure_worktree._create_worktree()` currently only runs `git worktree add -b ... <base_ref>`; it does not perform the design-required `branch --unset-upstream` or verify that a bare push cannot target the base branch. Add the operation immediately after creation and assert `@{upstream}` is absent before handing the worktree to an agent.

suggestions.title: Treat ledger claims as a transaction with explicit handoff states
suggestions.rationale: The existing `/sdd-fix` contract requires releasing every successful claim on every failure path. `/sdd-brief` adds failures during source fetch, research, Q&A, worktree creation, and brief commit, while `/sdd-done` must not close a ledger issue merely when it opens a PR. Reuse the claim/release discipline, persist the claimed issue in the brief, and print an exact close command only after merge confirmation; add abort and retry behavior for each phase.

suggestions.title: Replace old empty-feat hotfix tests with brief-shape integration coverage
suggestions.rationale: Current tests explicitly encode the old behavior that an empty `feat_id` means no per-spec index and that hotfixes use the existing spec flow. The migration needs tests for brief index discovery, `HOTFIX-*` task IDs, null-or-stable identity handling, ledger `dev` base resolution, main PR refusal/creation, and `/sdd-done` validation-command execution.

suggestions.title: Define a non-negotiable minimum for light research
suggestions.rationale: The anti-goal forbids guess-shaped briefs, but `--research light` is otherwise underspecified. Require every successful mode, including light mode, to record a fetched/identified source, root-cause statement, and at least one verified `path:line` anchor; refuse worktree creation when those fields are absent. This makes the shortcut falsifiable rather than an implicit research bypass.
